decisions.decision: Use --label <label> as the optional argument and remove its token pair before identifying path filters.
decisions.why: It lets developers name a source in the same command without changing the existing positional URL/path and filter forms.
decisions.rejected: Treating the label as a positional token, which could make it ambiguous with folder filters.

decisions.decision: An explicit label replaces the label on a matching URL and revision; when omitted, preserve an existing label or use the current derivation rules.
decisions.why: An explicit choice should take effect on the source it names while preserving established defaults.
decisions.rejected: Ignoring an explicit label when updating an already configured source.

concerns.note: Configure behavior is expressed as agent instructions rather than executable parser code, so label acceptance is checked with command-contract assertions instead of an end-to-end parser test.
